items.title_zh: X 发帖 @oscarpiastri81：是的，Oscar今天确实拿了分，但这个赛季不知怎么地连我都快崩溃了，说实话这真是了不起的成就。既然我们已经确定即使是我，尽管24/7靠希望撑着，也会被击垮，我想讨论一下如何找回我的理智。我可以直接和谁谈？
items.summary: Yes, Oscar did score points today, but this season is somehow breaking even me, which is honestly quite an achievement. Now that we’ve established that even I can be broken despite running on hopium 24/7, I’d like to discuss getting my sanity back. Who can I speak to directly?
